**Summary:** The 30 km radius around The French Laundry (Yountville, CA) is Napa Valley wine country — not a tech hub. Three upcoming 2026 events qualify: PV ModuleTech USA (Jun 16-17, cleantech/solar at the Napa Valley Marriott), Operating Partners Forum Napa (Jun 23-25, PE/AI at Silverado Resort), and Summit Napa Valley (Oct 12-14, business leadership/AI at the Meritage Resort). All three venues are 10-16 km from The French Laundry. Key practical tip: book TFL first (~8 weeks out), then align with conference dates — not the other way around.
